title: blemees-workflow trust grant
description: Schema for individual trust-grant files under `trust-grants/<process>/<gate>.json`. Per-team relaxations of catalogued human gates. Cross-reference checks (control_point matches a real human gate; current_level in the gate's allowed_levels; evidence currency) run in `workflow validate-workflow`.

workflow.description: Process name the gate belongs to (matches the parent directory name).

current_level.description: Effective gating level under this grant. Must be in the human gate's `allowed_levels` (enforced by validator).

on_timeout.description: What happens when `timeout` elapses without resolution.

escalate_to.description: Role / channel to escalate to when `on_timeout` is `escalate`.

evidence.description: At least one evidence entry justifying the grant (per trust-grant-schema.md § 7.5).

granted_by.description: Principal (person or body) who granted the relaxation.

granted_at.description: ISO-8601 date the grant took effect.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 date the grant expires. Must be strictly after `granted_at`.

review_cadence.description: How often this grant is re-reviewed.

authorized_revokers.description: Principal(s) who may revoke. String or array of strings.

source.description: Where the evidence comes from (e.g., dashboard name, audit log).
